title: Learning Anisotropic Prediction Targets for Flow Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality. We introduce Anisotropic Flow Models (AnisoFlow), which replaces a fixed prediction target with a fully learnable one. AnisoFlow learns to scale the noise component of the target anisotropically, assigning a separate nonnegative weight to each direction in a jointly learned basis. A closed-form map recovers the velocity from the network's prediction, leaving the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. Since recovery is exact, training optimizes the target purely to make it easier for the network to predict. We theoretically analyze the resulting prediction error and predict that the preferred noise weight in each direction scales near-linearly with data variance, in agreement with the weights learned empirically in pixel space. translated_title: 面向流模型学习各向异性预测目标
translated_abstract: 基于流的生成模型通常在人工选定的预测目标（如速度、噪声或干净数据）上进行训练，这一选择对训练过程和样本质量有显著影响。我们提出了各向异性流模型，用一个完全可学习的预测目标取代固定的预测目标。AnisoFlow 学习以各向异性的方式缩放目标中的噪声分量，即在联合学习的基中为每个方向分配一个独立的非负权重。通过一个闭式映射即可从网络的预测中恢复速度，从而保持网络架构、流匹配损失和采样器完全不变。由于恢复是精确的，训练可以纯粹以使网络更容易预测为目标来优化预测目标。我们从理论上分析了由此产生的预测误差，并预测每个方向上的最优噪声权重与数据方差近似呈线性关系，这与在像素空间中通过实验学到的权重相吻合。
tldr: 该论文提出各向异性流模型，将固定的预测目标替换为完全可学习的目标，通过对噪声分量进行各向异性缩放并利用闭式映射精确恢复速度，在不改变网络架构、损失函数和采样器的情况下优化训练与生成质量。
en_tdlr: AnisoFlow replaces the hand-chosen prediction target of flow models with a fully learnable one via anisotropic noise weighting, enabling exact velocity recovery through a closed-form map and improving training without altering the architecture, loss, or sampler.
